job_hotdog_corner.text: Ecto-1, come in. We got one. The hot dog stand on North Moore and Varick, right around the corner. Something green is eating everything on the cart. Then the cart.

job_chinatown.text: Ecto-1, we got a call. Golden Dragon on Mott and Canal. Something is eating the whole kitchen, and the owner wants to know who's paying for the duck.

job_wtc_plaza.text: Ecto-1, come in. World Trade Center plaza, Church and Vesey. Security says there's a pack of little glowing things on the fountain. A lot of them.

job_wall_street.text: Guys, Trinity Church, Broadway and Wall. The organist says the graveyard is, quote, getting up. I didn't ask.

job_battery_pier.text: Ecto-1, Battery pier, all the way down at the tip. A cab drove off the pier. The driver's still in it. He's been dead since nineteen forty.

job_soho_loft.text: Ecto-1, Greene and Spring, the old cast iron lofts. An artist says his sculptures are howling. He thinks it's a ghost, I think it's the sculptures.

job_subway_canal.text: Canal Street subway, Canal and Seventh Avenue South. The token booth lady says the trains are coming out of the tunnel with nobody driving.

job_washington_square.text: Ecto-1, Washington Square, by the arch. Something big and black with red eyes is chasing the chess players. They want their money back.

job_herald_square.text: Herald Square, Broadway and Thirty-Fourth. A taxi with no driver keeps doing laps around the square. Honking. At night.

job_library_steps.text: Ecto-1, come in. Library steps, Fifth Avenue and Forty-Second. There's an old lady floating between the lions, telling people to be quiet.

job_library_reading_room.text: We got one inside the New York Public Library, the main reading room. Books flying off the shelves. The librarian is very upset, and I mean the live one.

job_times_square.text: Ecto-1, Times Square, Broadway and Seventh. Half the city is out there watching something eat a hot dog truck. Try not to be on TV.

nav_recalc.text: Okay, wrong turn. Hold on, I'm finding you another way.

nav_arrive.text: That's the place. Go get it.

cap_1.text: You got it? Nice. Now get it back here before it gets out.

cap_2.text: That's one. Bring the trap home, the containment unit is waiting.

slime_1.text: Did it slime you? Do not get that in the car.

paid_1.text: The city paid. Minus the damage. Again.

paid_2.text: Payment's in. You broke less stuff this time. Barely.

nav_home.text: Okay, head back to the Firehouse. I'll talk you in.
